posts.title: Transport should be for the public
posts.description: The UK, with few exceptions, is car dependent. Our public and active transport systems are severely underinvested in and underutilised, which has a wide-ranging knock-on effect on all our public spaces, services and designs. But there's hope for change - and a wealth of evidence to guide us to it.
